prompt.project_info: Create a photorealistic indoor sci-fi cosplay portrait of an original approved adult character in a hobby bedroom.
prompt.main_subject: An original approved adult woman with pale skin, light blue eyes, subtle eyeliner, and dark emerald-teal straight bob hair with blunt bangs wears a gold metallic headpiece with a triangular teal gem and small fin-like horns. She kneels thoughtfully on a soft carpet with one gloved hand near her chin and the other supporting her.
prompt.composition_elements: Eye-level medium portrait, intricate black, dark teal, gold, and white fantasy-sci-fi costume, black gloves with glowing teal circuit lines and pointed gold finger-claws, gold shoulder armor with teal emblems, geometric gold-trim bodice, flowing white-teal-lime waist panels, modular drawers, original figurines, neutral walls, outlet, and framed wall photo.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft diffused indoor light, gentle background falloff, luminous teal costume details, realistic skin and fabric texture, thoughtful high-fidelity cosplay mood.
prompt.technical_specs: Realistic portrait photography, vertical 4:5, eye-level medium framing, 50mm lens perspective, sharp subject with softly blurred background, natural color and subtle grain, no artificial HDR look.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Photorealistic vertical 4:5 indoor sci-fi cosplay portrait of an original approved adult woman with pale skin, light blue eyes, subtle eyeliner, and dark emerald-teal straight bob hair with blunt bangs. She wears a gold metallic headpiece with a triangular teal gem and fin-like side details, black gloves with glowing teal circuit lines and pointed gold finger-claws, gold shoulder armor with teal emblems, a dark teal geometric bodice with gold trim, and flowing white, teal, and lime fabric panels. She kneels thoughtfully on a soft pinkish-beige carpet with one gloved hand near her chin and the other supporting her. Modular drawers, original figurines, neutral walls, and a framed photo sit behind her. Soft diffused indoor light, realistic texture, high-fidelity cosplay photography.
